description: For permit inspection, this checklist records prerequisite completion, accessibility, test readiness, correction history, required documents, and representative attendance. Its supporting evidence includes approved-plan set, permit card, photos, test results, product approvals, inspector comments, and correction proof.

title: Permit Inspection Checklist
use_case: Use the checklist during permit inspection readiness and result control when the permit inspection record must identify permit number, authority, inspection type, location, approved plans, responsible contractor, and requested window. Complete the applicable handoff for inspection result, correction assignment, reinspection date, approval evidence, and downstream release.
